title: Pinto, from: 100 Years ago
medium: Etching in colours, on wove paper

said.q: This piece is part of Doig’s “100 Years Ago” series, which comprises eight etchings exploring themes of memory and landscape. “Pinto”, Doig depicts a solitary horse standing in a serene, open field, evoking a sense of stillness and contemplation.

events.q: is a colour etching created between 2000 and 2001
